feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 18 June 2026 9:02am
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy with rain this morning, heavy at times, clearing to become largely dry through the afternoon. Coastal mist and fog patches are likely to affect southern and eastern areas later helping to create a warm and muggy night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

8-12, risk of 15 on hills.


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, increasing 20-25 late morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and rain and very poor in fog. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Heavy rain at times this morning.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with rain arriving in the morning, heavy at times, with intermittent spells in the afternoon and evening, then becoming dry overnight into Saturday. Occasional areas of mist and fog patches throughout the period.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

8-12, risk of 15 on hills.


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S-SW 20-25, decreasing 10-20 later in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and rain and very poor in fog. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later in the afternoon. Heavy rain at times.


##Saturday, 20 June 2026##

Dry and bright with sunny spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 10-15, decreasing 10 or less overnight, then backing mainly E or SE later, but variable at times.


##Visibility##

Mostly good. Risk of poor or very poor at first.


##Comments##

Risk of mist/fog at first, and isolated hill fog throughout.


##Sunday, 21 June 2026##

Dry, bright and warm with lengthy sunny spells, hazy at times.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

8


##Wind Direction##

NE


##Wind##

Mainly E or NE 5-10, occasionally 15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Monday, 22 June 2026##

Dry, bright and very warm with sunny spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 21°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

8

SE
